trap-negation-contrast.notes: Two content items reported to the batch, neither a trap category. (1) The block calls I_8 and I_9 'quotient ideals' but what it defines are conditional REWRITING rules ('absorbed into sigma_{i+1} WHEN THE LATTER IS PRESENT in the normal form', 'absorbed WHEN ITS PREFIX w IS PRESENT'). An ideal is closed under addition and under multiplication by the algebra and is specified by generators; a rule whose applicability depends on what else is present in a particular normal form is not one. Either give the generators of the ideals or call these reduction rules. This matters because the block is a definition with a Lean sibling (QOU.OptimalNF.GSQuotientIdealsI8I9), where the distinction is load-bearing. (2) The subscripts 8 and 9 presuppose I_1..I_7 elsewhere; the block does not say where.
